data.name: Enigma Of Forest
data.detailed_description:
Enigma of Forest is a 1-4 player co-op ritual horror game.
In a cursed village hidden deep within the forest, an ancient evil has awakened.
You and your friends must survive the night, uncover the mystery, and complete the ritual to banish the darkness.

🔥 1-4 Player Co-op


Play solo or team up with friends to face the horrors lurking in the shadows.

🕯️ Challenging Gameplay


Collect mystical artifacts, resist the minions of darkness, and survive the escalating threat.

🌲 Themed Maps & Ritual Mechanics


Explore a haunted village, eerie church, forgotten graveyard, and underground dungeons — each hiding pieces of the forgotten curse.

🧩 Escalating Difficulty


The longer you stay, the stronger the evil becomes. Every step increases the tension.

😈 Nightmare Mode


For the bravest players — an unforgiving mode where survival is nearly impossible.

🎮 Multiplayer Features


Seamless online co-op, team strategies, and unpredictable outcomes with every session.

⚠️ Horror Elements


Enigma of Forest contains intense horror themes, jumpscares, and unsettling atmosphere. Not recommended for the faint of heart.

⸻

Step into the cursed forest.
Light your lantern.
And discover the truth behind the forgotten evil.
